AI and your engineering tools

AI for Maxsurf Complete

AI for Maxsurf Complete should make the vessel, design condition and engineering question explicit. A useful planning request distinguishes hull modelling from stability or performance analysis, then identifies the information needed to review a result.

Maxsurf Complete · Available

Maxsurf Complete is available in the Vector OS beta. Supported modules, features and host versions depend on your build.

Keep the design condition attached to the question.

Two vessel results are not comparable simply because their hulls look similar. The loading condition, displacement, draft, coordinate system and analysis assumptions matter. Use AI to frame a bounded review request, while keeping naval-architecture judgement and acceptance with the responsible engineer.

An example request to plan.

Illustrative request, subject to the supported scope of your build.

Prepare a review checklist for comparing these two hull options at the same displacement and design draft. Identify missing loading assumptions and the outputs needed to judge the comparison. Do not infer a stability approval.

State the intended Maxsurf module and build, the vessel revision and the supplied analysis basis. Identify whether figures come from a model, an approved calculation or an illustrative concept. Keep units and condition names visible.

What should you check?

  • Check hull identity, units, loading basis and applicable criteria.
  • Verify solver inputs and source results before drawing a design conclusion.
  • Confirm module and feature support for your build; the beta label does not qualify every analysis.

Review selected context and native approval before a supported change.

Website samples are scripted and do not connect to or change your CAD software. Beta access, host versions and supported actions require separate confirmation. Check Windows beta access.
